topic: Practical on different wire locking techniques used during maintenance.
syllabus_extract: Practical on different wire locking techniques used during maintenance.
specific_objectives: 21.1.10.1 Trainee will be able to explain how to carry out DI / DR on aircraft system.

training_aids.remarks: Refer to the master syllabus reference list
Objective: teach the syllabus extract for this lesson

practical: Demonstration and practice of DI/DR wire locking techniques using dummy harnesses; Safety: Ensure power off, wear PPE; Supervision: Instructor monitors knot tightness and tool usage.
intro_questions: What is the primary purpose of wire locking in aircraft maintenance?
Name two common types of wire locking techniques used in aviation.
Why is it critical to inspect wire locks before flight?

topics: Introduction to DI and DR wire locking
development.content:
Introduction to DI and DR wire locking
Tools required for wire locking
Step-by-step DI wire locking procedure
Step-by-step DR wire locking procedure
Common errors in wire locking

Inspection criteria for wire locks
Safety precautions during wire locking
Troubleshooting loose or damaged locks
Documentation of wire locking work
Quality assurance checks

Final verification of wire locking
Cleaning and storage of tools
Review of DI/DR procedures
Addressing trainee queries
Preparation for next lesson

summary_questions: Explain the difference between DI and DR wire locking techniques.
Describe the steps to verify a correctly installed wire lock.
